_comment: The DEFAULT config mounted at /etc/opencode when nothing else is chosen (raw `bin/harness` callers). One `local` provider behind the LLM door, http://llm:8080/v1, which forwards to the one host port in LLM_TARGET_PORT. Replace `local-model` with the id your server lists on /v1/models and set the limits to what it was launched with. Under airlock, LOCAL_MODEL=endpoint renders dev/opencode-endpoint/opencode.json.tmpl per project instead, and a backends plugin (README.md, 'LLM backends') can point at its own config dir. Auto-compaction stays off: opencode crashed on a tool call during the summary.

local.name: Local (OpenAI-compatible server behind the LLM door)

local-model.name: local-model (replace with your server's model id)
